deliverables.text: Enter a vague idea, problem, or goal as free text and start immediately — no structured input required
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: One free-text pill plus four starter chips; clicking a chip fills the box rather than submitting. Shown by day-one-nothing-yet and the IdeaForm/SuggestionChips component scenarios.

deliverables.text: The AI deconstructs instead of answering: it asks a small number of high-value clarifying questions
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: System prompt instructs naming unknowns and asking two or three high-value questions instead of proposing a solution; questions render bold on their own lines. Shown by seed-planted-three-open-questions. NOT exercised against a live model - no API key in this environment.

deliverables.text: A live visual map that grows as the conversation develops (idea, users, problem, goals, assumptions, open questions)
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Tidy-tree layout with dotted connectors and status-driven node treatments across all seventeen node kinds. Shown by eight application scenarios and eight MapNodePill component scenarios.

deliverables.text: AI-assisted research grounded in live web search, attached to the map as findings and gaps rather than a list of links
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Anthropic's server-side web_search tool is wired into the same Messages call, with findings and gaps modelled as research/finding/gap nodes. Shown by grounded-research-and-its-gaps. Code complete but NOT exercised live - no API key in this environment.

deliverables.text: Changing direction updates the map and explains what changed, without losing the original idea
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Direction changes add and update rather than erase; the changed node wears the lime and the caption reads 'nothing gets lost, only added'. Shown by pivoted-now-it-is-for-teachers.

deliverables.text: A final actionable output: what we know, what we do not know, the strongest directions, and concrete next steps
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Summary screen with know / don't-know / three directions / five numbered steps. Shown by complete-what-to-do-next and the SummaryView component scenarios.

deliverables.text: After the plan is produced, keep discussing and working — the conversation continues and the map keeps evolving
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: The summary screen keeps the conversation panel open beneath it under a Keep thinking heading, so the plan is a starting point rather than a dead end.

deliverables.text: Thinking maps persist so you can leave and return to one later
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Maps, messages and nodes persist in SQLite; the landing screen lists saved maps with the phase each reached. Shown by returning-four-saved-maps, one-saved-map and many-saved-maps.

deliverables.text: An MCP server exposing the same planning tools over the same map data
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Six MCP tools over the same mapStore the web UI uses, on both HTTP (/api/mcp) and stdio (npm run mcp). Verified live: initialize, tools/list, and a create/add-node/read round trip.

deliverables.text: ASSIST TRACK (not this build flow): registering the MCP server in a client such as Claude Desktop
deliverables.resolvedInFeature: Thinking Map: idea to plan loop
deliverables.note: Machine configuration and a walkthrough, not code — belongs to the assist track. User approved this deferral at the plan gate.
